subject: Re: MAP & next steps — FinPay discovery
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@finpay.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: FinPay discovery — quick recap & MAP template

Hi Asha — thanks again for the time today. High level recap below from our discovery call and a blank MAP template attached. Please review and confirm or edit as you see fit.

Key takeaways:
- Primary use case: real-time invoice classification + payor routing for high-volume enterprise customers (10k+ invoices/day).
- Decision criteria: latency under 200ms p95 for routing calls, accuracy target ~95% on vendor matching, clear audit logs and retention controls.
- Stakeholders mentioned: Product (you), Procurement (Michael), Security/Legal (Sofia), and IT ops (unspecified).
- Procurement timeline: Asha suggested an initial procurement review week of Mar 8, with contract negotiation to follow.

Attachments: FinPay-MAP-template.xlsx (blank MAP with milestones)

Next steps I proposed:
1) You share the full stakeholder list and their roles/decision authority (economic buyer, legal reviewer, procurement lead) — ideally by EOD Wed Feb 25.
2) I'll populate the MAP with milestones (PO, security review, pilot sign-off, production go-live) and share a living doc.
3) Proposed follow-up: 30-min alignment call week of Mar 1 to confirm timelines and open items.

Questions for you: who is the economic buyer for this initiative, and is there a standard procurement SOW / security questionnaire we should be aware of?

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Asha Rao <asha@finpay.com>

Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinPay discovery — quick recap & MAP template

Thanks Marissa — great summary and appreciate the template. Quick answers below and I attached our procurement checklist.

Stakeholder mapping (high level):
- Economic buyer: Sanjay Patel, VP Finance (sanjay.patel@finpay.com) — final sign-off on spend.
- Evaluation lead: me (Product) — primary technical/requirements owner.
- Procurement lead: Michael Li <michael.li@finpay.com> — handles SOW and PO.
- Legal/security reviewer: Sofia Torres (legal) — will run the security questionnaire and data handling review.
- IT ops: Lucas Reyes — will own integration and infra onboarding.

Decision criteria:
- Accuracy & latency as you noted.
- Controls: SOC 2 evidence, customer data isolation, KMS support for key management.
- Pricing: pay-per-token with predictable committed spend option (we prefer committed capacity if discounts are meaningful).

Procurement timeline: procurement kickoff week of Mar 8, security questionnaire returned by Mar 12, contract redlines by Mar 19. Target pilot start Apr 5.

Attached: FinPay-procurement-reqs.pdf

We'll review your MAP and give feedback.

Regards,
Asha
Director of Product, FinPay
asha@finpay.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: FinPay discovery — quick recap & MAP template

Looping you both in — Asha confirmed stakeholder map and procurement timeline. A few notes for negotiation prep:
- Economic buyer is Sanjay Patel (VP Finance) — likely focused on predictable unit economics. Explore committed capacity pricing.
- Legal/security review by Sofia — she'll request SOC 2 and possibly higher retention controls. Have SOC 2 report + data retention options handy.
- Pilot target Apr 5 — tight if security questionnaire takes to the 12th and contract redlines by Mar 19.

Action items for us:
1) Vivek: draft a MAP with milestones + responsibilities and proposed committed capacity tier options for Sanjay to evaluate.
2) Rishi: prepare SOC 2 evidence and a short note on our data isolation/KMS options to send to Sofia.
3) I'll follow up with Asha to confirm a Mar 1 alignment call and share the MAP doc link.

Thanks — will update as I hear back.

Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@finpay.com>
Cc: Michael Li <michael.li@finpay.com>, Sofia Torres <sofia.torres@finpay.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: proposed milestones & owners (FinPay) — please review

Hi Asha / team — per our thread, I populated the MAP with proposed milestones and owners. Link to living doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bFinPay-MAP

Proposed MAP (high level):
- Milestone 1 — Procurement kickoff (FinPay: Michael Li) — target week of Mar 8 — deliverable: signed NDAs, procurement checklist submitted.
- Milestone 2 — Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence (FinPay: Sofia / Redwood: Rishi) — target by Mar 12 — deliverable: completed questionnaire + SOC2 summary.
- Milestone 3 — Contract redlines & commercial terms (FinPay: Sanjay & Michael / Redwood: Marissa + Legal) — target by Mar 19 — deliverable: redlined contract and summary of open items.
- Milestone 4 — Pilot readiness & test data onboarding (FinPay: Lucas / Redwood: Eng) — target Apr 5 — deliverable: pilot runbook and success criteria met.
- Milestone 5 — Production go-live & PO (FinPay: Sanjay) — target Apr 26 — deliverable: PO issuance and production traffic.

Open questions for the MAP:
1) Is Sanjay the sole economic buyer or is sign-off required from CFO as well?
2) Any specific compliance controls beyond SOC 2 we should pre-seat (e.g., FedRAMP, PCI scope notes)?
3) Preferred cadence for MAP updates (weekly via email or biweekly sync)?

Next steps: please confirm stakeholder list and any edits to milestones by EOD Fri Feb 27. If helpful, I'm happy to hop on a 30-min alignment call Mon Mar 1 10:00am PT — does that work for the key stakeholders?

Thanks — attaching the MAP template again and the procurement checklist you shared.

Attachments: FinPay-MAP-template.xlsx, FinPay-procurement-reqs.pdf

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Michael Li <michael.li@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Asha Rao <asha@finpay.com>
Cc: Sofia Torres <sofia.torres@finpay.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finpay.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: proposed milestones & owners (FinPay) — please review

Thanks Marissa — looks good. Confirming procurement will kick off week of Mar 8. A few notes:
- Sanjay will be the economic buyer, but CFO will be looped for spends > $250k. Please include committed capacity options in the commercial, and a 60-day trial clause would be helpful for execs to see ROI.
- I'll run the SOW/PO timeline with finance and aim to return redlines by Mar 19 as noted.
- Sofia will send the security questionnaire to Rishi by EOD Feb 25.

We can do the Mar 1 call — I'll confirm invite for 10am PT and make sure Sanjay can join for 15 minutes.

-Michael
notes: This thread is a sales discovery follow-up focused on stakeholder mapping and creation of a Mutual Action Plan (MAP). Internal action items were assigned to AE and Sales leadership to prepare SOC2 evidence and pricing tiers. External stakeholders confirmed timelines. Follow-up items: confirm Sanjay as economic buyer, return security questionnaire by Feb 25, and schedule Mar 1 alignment call.
